datasets.title: Côte d'Ivoire - Côte d'Ivoire - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Côte d'Ivoire with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/co-te-d-ivoire-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters using gridded population data (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta), assigning representative points to each cluster, and applying Voronoi tessellation to delineate catchment boundaries. Population counts were disaggregated by sex and age from multiple sources, and building inventories were compiled from OpenStreetMap and Google imagery with confidence filtering, then aggregated within each settlement catchment polygon.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to disaggregate population within settlement catchments

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: High-resolution population distribution data (2023) integrated into settlement population estimates

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Demographic data including sex and age-disaggregated population counts (2023) for settlements

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data (2024) used to count and measure building structures within settlements

sources.name: Google
sources.description: High-confidence building detections (2023) at multiple confidence thresholds integrated with settlement building inventories
